originalTitle: Should You Be Worried About Stanley Black & Decker Stock?

Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) stock returned 47.5% over the past year, against 15.0% for the S&P 500. Its margins have recovered too. Operating margin was 9.2% over the four quarters to July 2026, up from 6.7% a year earlier. Yet on its July 29, 2026 call, management said a cost refunded in the latest quarter should return within months. What is that cost, and how much did its refund add to the quarter?

Stanley Black & Decker’s Tariff Costs Are Coming Back

The cost is tariffs. Stanley Black & Decker received refunds of earlier tariffs in the second quarter of fiscal 2026. Management said those net refunds added about 250 basis points to its adjusted gross margin in the second quarter.

That tailwind is ending. Management said in July that new tariffs were likely to arrive within a few months at the same level as the old ones, so its underlying tariff costs would go back to where they were before the refunds. The company is due to update that view with its third-quarter results on November 4, 2026. The company excludes any further refunds from its second-half guidance because their timing and amounts are too uncertain.

Tariffs are not the only pressure. Management said inflation in battery metals, tungsten, oil and oil derivatives remains persistent, and that a price increase appears more likely than not to be needed by 2027. The warning comes from the company itself: the refund that lifted the quarter was temporary, and the other costs have not eased.

How Much Of Stanley Black & Decker Is Exposed?

Sales in that segment have moved little. They slipped 0.5% in fiscal 2024, and management said they rose 3% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026. Management expects the segment’s growth in fiscal 2026 to come from market share gains in a roughly flat to down market.

The stock is priced near its high. It closed on October 27, 2026 just 3.7% below its highest close of the past year. The price-to-sales multiple of 0.98 sits well below its 2021 peak of 2.3, but above its 2022 low of 0.64. Against the market, the shares trade at 24.0 times earnings, above 22.6 for the S&P 500. Those earnings include the second-quarter tariff refunds.

How Worried Should Stanley Black & Decker Holders Be?

The risk is real and close, but it is not a surprise. Management’s forecast for fiscal 2026 already assumes the tariff costs come back. On that basis, the company still raised its adjusted earnings guide to $5.20 to $5.80 per share. It expects productivity and tariff mitigation, including the move out of China, to lift adjusted gross margin to 34% to 35% in the second half. In the second quarter, that margin was 33.7%, including the boost from the refunds.

The shares have fallen harder than the market before. During the 2025 tariff sell-off between February and June, the stock fell as much as 36% from its peak, against 19% for the S&P 500. Today’s price appears to assume that management’s plan to offset the tariffs works.

Adjusted gross margin is the measure to watch when Stanley Black & Decker reports its third quarter, expected in November 2026.

Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) 的股票去年回报率为 47.5%，而标准普尔 500 指数的回报率为 15.0%。其利润率也有所恢复。截至 2026 年 7 月的四个季度，营业利润率为 9.2%，高于去年同期的 6.7%。然而，管理层在 2026 年 7 月 29 日的电话会议上表示，最近一个季度退还的成本应该会在几个月内收回。该费用是多少？其退款为本季度增加了多少？

史丹利百得的关税成本正在回归

成本就是关税。 Stanley Black＆Decker 在 2026 财年第二季度收到了早期关税的退款。管理层表示，这些净退款使其第二季度调整后毛利率增加了约 250 个基点。

顺风顺水即将结束。管理层在7月表示，新关税可能会在几个月内达到与旧关税相同的水平，因此其基本关税成本将回到退款前的水平。该公司将于 2026 年 11 月 4 日在第三季度业绩中更新这一观点。该公司在下半年指导中排除了任何进一步的退款，因为退款的时间和金额都太不确定。

关税并不是唯一的压力。管理层表示，电池金属、钨、石油和石油衍生品的通胀依然持续，到 2027 年似乎更有可能需要提价。警告来自公司本身：提振本季度的退款是暂时的，其他成本并未缓解。

史丹利百得公司有多少被曝光？

该细分市场的销售额变化不大。他们在 2024 财年下滑了 0.5%，管理层表示他们在 2026 财年第二季度增长了 3%。管理层预计该部门在 2026 财年的增长将来自于大致持平或下滑的市场中的市场份额增长。

该股的价格接近最高点。该股于 2026 年 10 月 27 日收盘，仅比去年最高收盘价低 3.7%。市销率为 0.98，远低于 2021 年峰值 2.3，但高于 2022 年低点 0.64。相对于市场而言，该股的市盈率为 24.0 倍，高于标准普尔 500 指数的 22.6 倍。这些盈利包括第二季度的关税退款。

史丹利百得持有者应该有多担心？

风险是真实且接近的，但这并不令人意外。管理层对 2026 财年的预测已经假设关税成本将会回升。在此基础上，该公司仍将调整后盈利指引上调至每股 5.20 美元至 5.80 美元。该公司预计，生产率和关税削减（包括撤出中国）将使下半年调整后毛利率提高至 34% 至 35%。第二季度，该利润率为 33.7%，其中包括退款带来的增长。

该股的跌幅比之前的市场还要严重。在 2025 年 2 月至 6 月期间的关税抛售期间，该股较峰值下跌了 36%，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌了 19%。今天的价格似乎假设管理层抵消关税的计划有效。

斯坦利百得 (Stanley Black & Decker) 预计将于 2026 年 11 月发布第三季度报告，调整后的毛利率是值得关注的指标。
